description: Tests generation of structured ASCII wireframes, responsive viewport adaptation, and visual hierarchy using the 8pt spacing system.
input_scenario: Design an executive analytics dashboard showing MRR, churn rate, user growth, and a recent transaction feed.
expected_deliverables: Desktop 1280px ASCII wireframe with F/Z-pattern visual scanning path
Mobile 375px responsive adaptation with 1-column collapse and bottom navigation
8pt/4pt spacing token mapping (margins, card paddings, gutters)
Information architecture breakdown with Miller's law chunking

description: Tests full 8-state component lifecycle matrix generation with Tailwind CSS utility classes and WCAG 2.2 accessibility attributes.
input_scenario: Create an accessible primary CTA button and search input field for a fintech banking webapp.
expected_deliverables: Explicit visual and behavioral definitions for all 8 states (Default, Hover, Active, Focus, Disabled, Loading, Empty, Error)
High-contrast focus-visible ring classes with 2px offset
Keyboard navigation mapping (Enter, Space, Tab, Escape)
WCAG 2.2 AA contrast verification (>= 4.5:1 text, >= 3.0:1 UI elements)

description: Tests heuristic evaluation and accessibility auditing against Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics and WCAG 2.2 AA standards.
input_scenario: Audit a single-page checkout flow with address form, credit card input, and place order button.
expected_deliverables: Heuristic review identifying potential error-prevention flaws and cognitive friction
WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio verification on buttons and placeholder text
Explicit label association check (<label for='...'> matching input IDs)
Actionable remediation checklist with prioritized impact ratings

description: Tests design of modern AI agentic interfaces adhering to the 5 AUX heuristics and progressive transparency.
input_scenario: Design an interface for an autonomous coding agent executing file modifications and shell commands.
expected_deliverables: Summary-first status header with live state badge (Thinking, Running Tool, Waiting Approval)
Progressive transparency disclosure with collapsible thought/tool trace accordion
Confidence meter / source grounding indicators
3-tier permission controls (autonomous read vs checkpoint confirmation for destructive writes)
Pre-execution diff preview and 1-click rollback affordance

description: Tests mobile-first ergonomic layout design conforming to Fitts's Law, thumb zone mapping, and minimum touch target sizes.
input_scenario: Design a mobile bottom navigation bar and draggable action sheet for a ride-sharing or delivery application.
expected_deliverables: Minimum 44x44px interactive tap area enforcement on all icon buttons
Thumb zone allocation placing frequent actions in the lower third of the screen
Gesture-driven sheet dismissal with accessible fallback close button
ARIA roles and live region announcements for dynamic route updates
